title: celtis leveillei var. heterophylla
intro: Celtis leveillei var. heterophylla, commonly known as the Chinese hackberry or Chinese nettle tree, is a plant species native to China. This plant is known for its various health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Celtis leveillei var. heterophylla are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
